subject: Recap & next steps — evaluation kickoff for EdgeSense
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps — evaluation kickoff for EdgeSense

Hi Sam / Maria,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid discussion on your latency and cost constraints for the RAG use case. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step to get an evaluation kicked off:  

What we heard (high level):
- Primary workload: document retrieval + generation for customer support (average prompt length ~250 tokens, peak concurrency ~120 req/s).
- Success criteria: median latency < 300ms for single-turn responses, cost per 1k requests below your current baseline, and no PII leakage (SOC2 controls required).
- Evaluation needs: trial environment with sample prompt set, metrics dashboard access, and a short technical deep-dive for your infra team.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep-dive + trial plan review + setup checklist). During that call we can: go over the trial plan, align success criteria and prompt set, and confirm who’s needed from each side (tech + procurement). I’ve attached my discovery notes for reference.

Please share 2–3 time windows that work next week (Mar 2–5), and let us know who from your side will join (Dev/Ops/Procurement). If you prefer, Rishi has a calendar link below to pick a slot directly.

Attachments: 20260301-Marissa-Discovery-Notes.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
